svg.title: Perishable — the market-memory mark
svg.desc: What you do not shift, you lose. A fish skeleton: snout, spine, ribs, forked tail. It says gone off in every kitchen in the world and it engraves at chit size as five strokes and a fork. The first draft was a heaped measure overflowing its rim, which is a picture of a glut - and a glut is precisely what this model stopped being about. Generated by tools/build-icons.mjs from data/pricing.json and data/components.json - do not edit. The ink plate alone is the black-and-white edition.
